items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Peter Mordo said, why not me, why not Eddie... so we put the whole family on a boat and over we went... I was taken to court on that one. The guy I had to take his place I would then--if I had taken him back, I would then have to let him go

ctx.x: Yes. And the one in (inaudible) was moving, so there was an opening and Peter Mordo said, why not me, why not Eddie, because they're not doing anything now--or Sperry said why not Eddie, because Sperry had met a very beautiful German girl and really wanted to stay in Germany and didn't know how to bring it about, so he figured this was a way to do it. That must have been in the back of his mind.
Again, it was one of those things I couldn't refuse; they wanted to do it, so we put the whole family on a boat and over we went.
